question: Do Tranche's FMV and TRAC residual assumptions hold up against the equipment's projected value at lease maturity?

tranche.source: src/modules/equipment-finance/constants.ts FMV_RESIDUAL_PCT and TRAC_RESIDUAL_PCT, scoring.ts getResidualValue, Deal_Screening_Model_Assumptions.md FMV and TRAC sections
tranche.fmvResidual: Flat % of cost by equipment type, the same at any term: Heavy Machinery 15, Vehicles/Fleet 25, Rail Cars 20, Marine 15, Aircraft 17, Medical 10, IT 5, Construction 15, Agricultural 15 (inherited), Energy 12, Engines 12 (inherited), Other 10.
tranche.check: None. Tranche does not compare the residual to value at maturity.

joel.note: Written before any residual benchmark or value-at-maturity figure was shown. Joel asked for benchmark research rather than give an expectation he could not back.
joel.residualLevel: No view on whether today's FMV residuals are too high, about right or too low.

decisions.valueBasis: Forced-sale value at maturity (liquidation haircut applied), matching liquidation LTV.
decisions.shortfall: Flag when coverage is below the limit, configurable in the credit box. Not a scored factor.
decisions.trac: Shown for information only, no flag. The lessee guarantees the residual.
decisions.scope: Check only. Flat residuals are not changed in this step. Making residuals term-dependent is a separate decision.
